title: The Artificial Personality Model: Theory, Implementation, Measurement and Experimental Validation in Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial personality shapes user experience (UX) in human-machine interaction, yet coherent theoretical frameworks and validated measurement instruments remain limited. This paper refines and empirically evaluates the Artificial Personality Model (APM), a hybrid framework integrating human-centred and machine-specific personality dimensions. Across three experiments (N = 395), the model was operationalised and evaluated using the Artificial Personality Questionnaire (APQ). Factor analyses revealed that some human personality dimensions (e.g., agreeableness, conscientiousness) are partially transferable, whereas others (e.g., extraversion) did not emerge as distinct dimensions. Additional machine-specific dimensions were identified. The APQ provided encouraging initial psychometric evidence, while the human-centred BFI-2 showed poor reliability and an uninterpretable factor structure in Experiment 3. translated_title: 人工人格模型：会话智能体中的理论、实现、测量与实验验证
translated_abstract: 人工人格塑造着人机交互中的用户体验（UX），然而连贯的理论框架和经过验证的测量工具仍然有限。本文对人工人格模型（APM）进行了改进和实证评估，该模型是一个整合了以人为中心的人格维度与机器特有人格维度的混合框架。在三项实验（N = 395）中，研究者使用人工人格问卷（APQ）对该模型进行了操作化定义与评估。因子分析表明，某些人类人格维度（如宜人性、尽责性）可以部分迁移至机器，而其他维度（如外向性）则未能显现为独立的维度。此外，研究还识别出了额外的机器特有人格维度。APQ提供了令人鼓舞的初步心理测量学证据，而在实验3中，以人为中心的BFI-2量表则表现出较差的信度和无法解释的因子结构。实验操纵证明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文改进并验证了人工人格模型（APM），发现部分人类人格维度（如宜人性、尽责性）可部分迁移至会话智能体，同时识别出机器特有人格维度，并开发了具有良好心理测量学特性的人工人格问卷（APQ）。
en_tdlr: This paper refines and validates the Artificial Personality Model (APM), showing that some human personality dimensions (e.g., agreeableness, conscientiousness) partially transfer to conversational agents while identifying machine-specific dimensions, and develops the Artificial Personality Questionnaire (APQ) with promising psychometric properties.
